title: Sara Duterte spox given until Nov. 23 to respond to Senate show-cause order
summary: Vice President Sara Duterte"s spokesperson Paolo Panelo has until Monday, November 23, to respond to the show-cause order issued against him by the Senate impeachment court over his remarks…

blocks.text: Vice President Sara Duterte’s spokesperson Paolo Panelo has until Monday, November 23, to respond to the show-cause order issued against him by the Senate impeachment court over his remarks questioning the impartiality of several senator-judges.
Senate impeachment court clerk Renato Bantug said the order was sent to Panelo via email on Friday, November 20.
“By email sent last [Friday] ang show cause order vs Paolo Panelo, given until tomorrow to respond,” Bantug said.
The show-cause order stemmed from Panelo’s remarks alleging that some senator-judges were acting as prosecutors in Duterte’s impeachment trial.
Senator-judge Erwin Tulfo raised the matter on Day 45 of the proceedings, asking Senate impeachment court presiding officer Francis Escudero if the court could take action on Panelo’s statements.
Panelo, however, maintained that his remarks were protected by his constitutional right to free speech.

“I welcome the opportunity to demonstrate that my comments were fair, made in good faith, and did not impede, obstruct, or degrade the administration of justice, and are thus constitutionally protected,” he said in an earlier statement.— MCG, GMA News
